app.name: Acme Analytics
app.description: Example dashboard toolset whose human controls and WebMCP handlers share the visible dashboard state.

tools.name: inspect_dashboard_series
tools.title: Inspect dashboard series
tools.description: Read the plotted series and source labels from the currently visible dashboard. Returns structured chart values, revision, and provenance; does not modify the dashboard.

seriesId.description: Identifier of a series currently visible in the chart.

maxPoints.description: Maximum number of plotted points to return.

registration.owner: The analytics dashboard route while the selected dashboard is visible.

preconditions: The analytics dashboard route is active.
The requested series is visible to the current authorized user.
successEvidence: The result contains the dashboard ID, series ID, point count, and source identifiers.
failureModes: The series is no longer visible.
The external data source is unavailable.

tools.name: set_dashboard_date_range
tools.title: Set dashboard date range
tools.description: Set the date range through the same action used by the visible dashboard controls and refresh its charts. Returns the applied dates, dashboard ID, and chart revision.

startDate.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

endDate.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

preconditions: The analytics dashboard route is active.
The current user may view the dashboard.
semantics.visibleEffect: The dashboard date controls and charts update to the applied range.
successEvidence: The result contains the applied start date, end date, dashboard ID, and chart revision.
The visible date controls match the returned range.
